description: Scoped Renovate: it manages ONLY the package-manager tooling (pnpm + corepack). Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) still owns every other ecosystem, so the two do not overlap. Runs self-hosted via .github/workflows/renovate.yaml.

packageRules.description: Dependabot owns all regular npm dependencies. Disable them here so Renovate only touches the packageManager field below.

pnpm lives in the packageManager field (single source of truth). Renovate's native handling can drop the +sha512 integrity hash (renovatebot/renovate#29184), which makes corepack fail closed, so a postUpgradeTask regenerates the hash via `corepack use` and commits it into the same PR.
corepack bootstraps pnpm in the container builds (node:26 no longer ships it). Plain version bump, no companion hash.

customManagers.description: The pinned corepack version in the Containerfile install lines (`npm install --global corepack@X.Y.Z`).
